## Overview

GM-facing document capturing invasion conspiracy mechanics, B's lingering will, monster hierarchy, and the three-way standoff.

---

## Design Rationale

Invasion is not random  -  it's divine conspiracy. Gods couldn't destroy mortals directly after B empowered them with magic. Invasion provides: existential threat (unifies mortals), reason to pray, population bleed.

## Key Decisions

### Divine Conspiracy (GM Secret)
- Gods orchestrated invasion as planned genocide
- B sacrificed itself to give mortals power to fight back
- Gods struck deals with Abyss, Nine Hells, Shadowfell, Feywild
- Planar breaches along Kythoria's coast (~400 years ago)
- Breaches sealed when mortals pushed too close to sources

### B's Lingering Will (GM Secret)
- B's remnants (Weave, metals, crystals) retain subconscious desire to become whole
- Monsters fell under influence after discovering crystals
- Self-feeding cycle: larger hoards = stronger pull
- This stalled the invasion  -  clusters abandoned genocide to hoard
- **Gods' Knowledge**: Didn't know at invasion -> Have since discovered -> Now hunting hoards and Covenant
- Dragon hoarding canonically caused by B's influence

### Monster Hierarchy
Strength-based. Five Major Generals emerged during the Abominable End. Khar'zul (Ulrath from Abyss) defeated by First Alliance. Three generals defeated (Khar'zul + 2 unnamed), two retreated (unnamed). Remaining undefined for flexibility.

### Three-Way Standoff
Gods want to prevent B's resurrection / Covenant wants to perform it / Monster army wants to destroy mortals. No faction has full control.

### Planes Clarification
Feywild/Shadowfell are Anchor Planes stabilizing Material Plane structurally. But entities within act independently  -  planes stabilize regardless of inhabitants' actions. No contradiction.

---

## Implications
Invasion's divine origin is deepest campaign conspiracy. Three-way standoff creates constant tension. Hoarding instinct gives monsters unexpected depth. Resurrection ritual is ultimate endgame goal.

## Open Questions
Four unnamed generals, ritual requirements, blackmail threshold, monster army breaking point, mortal discoverers.
